annotations.title: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 / draft-07)

description: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 / draft-07). Checks data against a schema: types, enum/const, numeric and string limits, patterns, formats (email, date-time, uri, uuid, ipv4/6, hostname), arrays, objects, $ref (same document), allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, if/then/else. Returns every error with its JSON Pointer path. Remote $ref is not fetched. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

data.description: Data to validate (any JSON value; a string is parsed as JSON when it is valid JSON, otherwise validated as a plain string)

schema.description: JSON Schema (a JSON value, or a string containing JSON)
